questions.question: Design a vertical steam Jacketed vessel of welded construction which is to contain 94 m3 of liquid at 93oC and a pressure of 3549*10^3 N/m2 after allowing 1/3rd of the reactor volume as free space. Two heads are to be standard dished head type. The reactor is to be provided with slow speed stirrer with 25 mm diameter shaft. Sight glass of 275 mm diameter is to be provided at the top along with a charge opening of 50 mm diameter. The bottom head is to have only a 50 mm diameter discharging nozzle. The steam jacket should have suitable connections for steam inlet, condensate outlet and vent. Steam jacket is to be designed when the steam supply is at 791*10^3 N/m2 and temperature of 170oC. Estimate the design dimensions of the reactor and the amount of heat, if the steam jacket is provided such that only bottom dished head is used to transfer heat energy into the vessel. It is given that the individual H.T.C in the reaction vessel is 825 J/m2.s.oC. Allowable stress for M. steel is 8962*10^5 N/m2. Design the vessel and draw the sectional elevation with all details. 50+50 *** Page 1 of 1

questions.question: An evaporator is to be fed with 5000 kg/ hr of solution containing 1% solute by weight. Feed is at a temperature of 35oC. It is to be concentrated to a solution of 1.5% solute by wt. in this evaporation operation at atmospheric pressure in the vapour space. Steam is supplied at 1.4 kg/cm2(g). BPE is negligible. Properties of feed solution may be taken as that of water. An overall H.T.C of 900 W/m2oC is assumed for the evaporator calendria. M.S tubes of 16 mm I.D, 19 mm O.D on 24 mm triangular pitch are used.(Assume L=1.5m) Design and 50+50 draw to scale.
